summary: docs/ is the active canon; successful turns finish through agent.finish.
the default readonly profile exposes finish, think, fs.read, fs.list, memory.search, and read-only kjxlkj resource tools.
AGENT_TOOL_PROFILE=mutable exposes request_confirmation and confirmed kjxlkj create/update tools; shell, web.fetch, fs.write, and memory.write stay disabled.
greetings, thanks, and simple questions should use agent.finish directly without filesystem or resource tools.
the runtime stops repeated identical non-terminal actions instead of rerunning the same failed tool call.
workspace tools are confined to TOOL_WORKSPACE_DIR and should use relative paths.
absolute filesystem paths are rejected by the local workspace tool and should be handled as recoverable tool failures.
memory.search retrieves durable memory only when it helps the current turn; memory.write is disabled in active profiles.
resource search accepts q, kind, scope, sort, cursor, direction, and limit.
resource.fetch reads a single kjxlkj resource by ref or id and returns resource fields for grounded answering.
history pages and JSON history share directional cursor semantics.
resource.preview_markdown previews markdown mutation output without committing a write and can run in the readonly profile.
resource.create_note accepts body plus optional alias, is_favorite, and is_private, and must be requested through confirmation.
resource.create_media accepts a workspace-confined path plus optional alias, is_favorite, and is_private, and must be requested through confirmation.
resource update accepts body, alias, is_favorite, and is_private.
when resource.search returns no matching resources, the agent should finish with a concise empty-result explanation instead of inventing resources.
the agent must not reveal secrets, credentials, private data, API keys, or raw local password files.
shell.exec is disabled in active profiles; command requests should not be trained as successful shell tool calls.
language files are flat JSON objects and missing keys fall back to English.
